svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Do not glue the cap: it lifts off with the probe for calibration.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Top: drill 22.5 mm in the centre for the 1/2 in conduit connector.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Side: drill 5 mm straight across, 9 above the tube end (the cap's

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: shoulder) and 9 off the centre line, for the M5 cross bolt.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The bolt passes beside the cable, never through it.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: the conduit connector goes through the top with its locknut

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: inside. The cable support grip's eye goes over the cross bolt,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: which then carries the probe and cable; nyloc nut outside.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The cap sits on the tube end by its own weight and the load.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: with the bolt in, the cap still slides on and off the tube.
